correctness.rationale: On the compact mass simplex with unit-rate independent edge Poisson clocks, left Beta(t,pt) resampling and right Beta(t,qt) resampling, a two-event common-randomness coupling contracts l1 in expectation by lambda=1/2+1/[4(1+p)]+q/[4(1+q)]<1, proving unique stationary law. First moments (1,p,pq)/(1+p+pq). For U=EX0^2, W=EX2^2,V=EX0X2, generator yields U=a(1-2m2+W), W=b(1-2m0+U), 2V=(m2-W)/(1+p)+q(m0-U)/(1+q); a=E R^2, b=E(1-S)^2, 0<a,b<1. Symbolic substitution yields C01=p[A(p,q)t-2Z]/(2Z²Delta) with strictly positive Delta and quadratic A=p²q(q+1)-p(q²+4q+2)-3q-2. Thus A<=0 means strict negativity and A>0 means unique sign reversal t*=2Z/A; A has unique positive p root. Independent exact symbolic rational p,q,t identity and generator checks verified this globally algebraically, including p=4,q=2 and critical 13/16. The full other-covariance sign classification is asserted only for p=4,q=2, not all p,q. The proof of unique stationary measure is analytical, not inferred from checks.
